visualRules.pixelScale: Hard-edged 1px pixel-art boundaries; no smoothing, no anti-aliased gradients, no procedural grass noise.

palette.note: Derived from the retained primary Web baseline (render.ts texel ramp + evidence captures) and the A1 terrain atlas wave rows as a MOTIF reference only. Exact 12-code -> Gameplay biome mapping still UNRESOLVED.

visualRules.ocean: PREFERRED baseline: deep-blue original Web ocean with LARGE sparse wave motifs and animated shore glints until a demonstrably better treatment is accepted; flat lake texture is NEVER used for ocean. Static preview frames only — runtime animated shore glints remain in Web render.ts and are not reimplemented.
visualRules.transitions: Hard-edged 1px material fringe derived from ACTUAL neighbouring biome codes, not random grass noise.
visualRules.landmarks: POI silhouettes come from Milestone D static footprints (roof/wall/portal geometry), Elder rings from canonical outer/core polygons, bridges from authored points. No code-painted prop replaces a stronger authored asset; no prop pack is imported.
visualRules.readability: Each region also has an after_ui view with a representative HUD frame to verify terrain and landmark legibility beneath UI. UI is a QA overlay only, NOT a gameplay HUD or a playable scene.
